import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    s = np.sqrt(T)
    return (params[0] + params[1]*T + params[2]*s + params[3]*np.log(T) + params[4]*T**2
            + params[5]*eps + params[6]*eps*s + params[7]*eps*T
            + params[8]*eps**2 + params[9]*eps**2*s)
